alpha_quartz_structure_retrieval_subtask.name: SiO2 Structure Retrieval for Surface Area
alpha_quartz_structure_retrieval_subtask.description: Retrieve structure of alpha-quartz SiO2 and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

alpha_quartz_potential_file_subtask_sa.name: SiO2 Potential File for Surface Energy
alpha_quartz_potential_file_subtask_sa.description: Procure an appropriate ReaxFF potential file for SiO2 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path of the potential file.

alpha_quartz_bulk_energy_minimisation_su.name: SiO2 bulk minimisation for Surface Energy
alpha_quartz_bulk_energy_minimisation_su.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible alpha-quartz SiO2 structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of alpha-quartz SiO2 based on given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in kcal/mol, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
alpha_quartz_bulk_energy_minimisation_su.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"BULK ENERGY": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structure/structure.dat"}

alpha_quartz_slab_energy_minimisation_su.name: SiO2 Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy
alpha_quartz_slab_energy_minimisation_su.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible alpha-quartz SiO2 structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, create a slab in the given direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform structure relaxation of the slab based on given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in kcal/mol, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
alpha_quartz_slab_energy_minimisation_su.submission_format: {"SLAB ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"SLAB ENERGY": "42.78", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/slab_structure.dat"}

alpha_quartz_subtask_sa.name: Silicon Surface Energy Calculation
alpha_quartz_subtask_sa.description: Given the paths to LAMMPS-compatible relaxed bulk and slab structures of alpha quartz SiO2, and the total energies (in kcal/mol) of its relaxed bulk and slab configurations, compute the surface energy of SiO2. Return the surface energy in kcal/(mol Å²).
